policy: Labels are orthogonal operational dimensions. Scales are bands, not verdicts: a high hotload/risk/impact band describes the mechanism/evidence needed, not whether work is allowed.

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: New capability or material capability expansion

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Defect in implemented or validated behavior

labels.name: type:architecture
labels.description: Architecture, protocol or subsystem design change

labels.name: type:research

labels.name: type:security
labels.description: Security, permissions, trust boundaries or provenance

labels.name: type:test

labels.name: type:refactor
labels.description: Internal restructuring without intended product behavior change

labels.description: Build, automation, diagnostics or developer tooling

labels.description: Latency, throughput, memory, startup or scalability work

labels.name: type:breaking

labels.name: hotload:H4-registry
labels.description: Registry virtualization and dynamic logical content

labels.description: Loader lifecycle replay/emulation with dependency ownership

labels.name: hotload:H6-epoch
labels.description: Structural engine/bootstrap change via Runtime Epoch Handoff

labels.name: trust:T0-data
labels.description: Declarative data only; no executable host authority

labels.name: priority:P0
labels.description: Critical path / blocks release or core architecture

labels.name: risk:R5
labels.description: Catastrophic if wrong; containment/rollback proof required

labels.name: failure:bootstrap-order
labels.description: Required transform/lifecycle point occurred too early

labels.name: failure:epoch-handoff
labels.description: Runtime Epoch Handoff fails or cannot retire prior epoch

labels.name: failure:dependency-cycle
labels.description: Reload dependency graph contains an invalid cycle

scale_semantics.hotload: H0-H6: minimum activation machinery required; H6 remains a supported public target through Runtime Epoch Handoff.
scale_semantics.trust: T0-T4: authority requested by a package; independent of whether the package is public.
scale_semantics.risk: R0-R5: blast radius if the implementation is wrong.
